_comment: TOOL is public code and documentation.
FIXTURE: none. The repository ships no fixtures and no fixture generator.
DATA is real runtime output in a separate PRIVATE versioned companion, never in this public repository.
The pinned guards enforce classification; qq_storage.py resolves through guards/tools/datadir.py and checks paths only; commit and push hooks keep DATA out of public repositories.
_audited: Pulls, recovery evidence, decoded output and output transaction files contain real runtime DATA. Every writing CLI resolves its destination inside the separate companion data/ directory before device access or writes; temporary files remain beside their private destination. A pull is explicitly an ownership-unverified candidate until key and account-field evidence passes. Decoder promotion is atomic. No raw or decoded archive can fall back into the public tool repository.
_data_home: QQ_HISTORY_EXPORT_DATA_DIR or QQ_HISTORY_EXPORT_CONFIG selects an existing private versioned companion data directory. No public or unversioned output fallback.
